Services & pricing guide

Your world, your avatar,
your story — captured differently.

Mimi Studio is a creative photography studio based in Second Life, making images that go beyond the traditional virtual portrait.

Book on Primfeed Explore the styles
Bahrain — Second Life — est. studio

From clean portraits and fashion editorials to cinematic scenes, artistic concepts and realistic transformations.

Every image is individually created to suit the personality, style and story of the client — no presets, no templates.

Whether you want your avatar preserved exactly as it is or reimagined entirely, the studio builds the shoot around what you're trying to say.

You choose how you want to be seen.

Five ways into a shoot — pick the one that fits the story, or combine a few. Every route starts the same way: your avatar, styled and posed with intention.

SL Original

The authentic avatar, beautifully composed

Second Life photography that preserves the look of your avatar exactly as it is. Perfect for profile pictures, fashion, couples, memories and social media.

Editorial

Your avatar, treated like a magazine cover

Your Second Life image transformed into a polished editorial photograph, with enhanced lighting, atmosphere, composition and detail — think fashion campaigns and cinematic photography.

Realistic — SL to real life

What your avatar might look like in the real world

Mimi Studio can transform your Second Life avatar into a realistic photographic interpretation, while keeping the character fully recognisable.

Creative concept

Built around your idea, mood or story

Send an idea, mood, story, song, character, or even a piece of writing, and the visual concept is developed around it — ideal for storytelling, fantasy scenes and personal art pieces.

Couples & groups

Portraits don't have to be solo

Couples, friendships, families and small groups can be photographed in SL or developed into a more cinematic or realistic final image.

How it works

Five steps from booking to final delivery, the same for every package.

01

Choose

Select your photography style — Original SL, Editorial, Realistic or Creative.

02

Shoot

The base photograph is created in Second Life, with attention to pose, composition, styling and lighting.

03

Create

Your photograph is edited and developed according to the style you've selected.

04

Preview

You'll receive a preview before the final delivery.

05

Yours

Your finished Mimi Studio image is delivered in high resolution, ready to post, frame or use as your profile picture.

Not every image needs to look perfect. Sometimes it needs to feel like something.

A memory that never happened. A photograph from another life. A movie that doesn't exist. A version of your avatar you've never seen before.

That's what Mimi Studio is here to create.
